fields.title.sub: Today we will focus on the things that make us a great team and work to improve our skills together all related to consistency.
fields.title.meta: The ASK System · Atlantic Family Dentistry
fields.agenda.p1: Hour 1 · Learn. Watch the Consistency course together, then take the quiz in your own account.
fields.agenda.p2: Hour 2 · Put it into practice. Three objectives: Own the Day, Present with Confidence, Connect First.
fields.agenda.p3: Hour 3 · See the whole team's picture. Our ASK Profile results, then quick 1-1's.
fields.s1d.h1: Why You're Busy and Still Behind
fields.s1d.sub: Our Consistency course. Watch together, then take the quiz and build your one-page plan.
fields.s1i.sub: Go around the room. Each person names ONE small thing they did consistently this week, not the big win, the boring repeat. Ten seconds each. No feedback, just naming.
fields.s1c.h2: Why You're Busy and Still Behind
fields.s1c.welcome: Welcome to The ASK System. We'll watch these five short segments together, clicking through them one at a time. Then you'll log into your account and take the quiz.
fields.s1a.cap: Your course, the quiz, your daily actions, and your drills all live here.
fields.s2.eyebrow: Hour 2 · 60 min · Put It Into Practice
fields.s2.sub: Not a rotation. Three habits we're installing together, each one a rep you protect.
fields.o1.p:
LENY
Read the schedule for opportunity. Yes to same-day until we can't. How can I make it work today?
fields.o2.p:
SAMMI
The three steps to a treatment yes: present and get the yes, request the timeline, transfer authority.
fields.o3.p:
DR YASSA
The F.O.R.E. interview and the 4 Values. Meet the patient before you present the plan.
fields.s2c.h2: "The single area of consistency from this morning I'm applying to my job is ___."
fields.s2c.sub: Fill in the blank for yourself. That's the rep you protect, starting tomorrow.
fields.br.note: Back on time keeps us on rhythm.
fields.s3d.sub: Here's where we stand on the ASK Profile: what it means for us, and what we're going to do about it.
fields.s3t.p1: Team zone: GROW. Overall 3.04 / 5.00 across the four C's. The foundation is real and the next zone is within reach.
fields.s3t.p2: Cooperation leads; Consistency is our growth edge, which is exactly what today is about.
fields.s311.stem: Stem: "In your experience, or by your ASK results…"
fields.q1.q: "What is most important to you about your work?"
fields.q2.q: "What tasks or actions make you feel successful when you do them?"
fields.q3.q: "What do you measure your success by?"
fields.s311.note: Use your cheat card (your own ALIGN / SHIFT / KEEP results) to answer.
fields.cl.sub: Pick the single keystone habit you'll install this week, small enough to keep on a bad day. Name it, name the boundary, name the day. One small rhythm, protected.
